files.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: square transparent game UI celebration icon for the dark 5tratum mining dashboard.
Primary request: one plump freshly baked golden ring donut, polished playful 3D product/game icon with realistic soft glaze; appetizing, tactile, premium, friendly without any face or mascot.
Composition/framing: square 1024x1024 canvas, centered single donut viewed from a gentle front three-quarter angle so the circular central hole is clearly visible; donut occupies about 70% of the width; generous safe transparent margins. Consistent silhouette and camera angle for a six-icon family.
Lighting: soft studio key light upper-left, clean highlights, subtle cool rim light for contrast against a very dark UI. Golden baked dough, soft rounded edges, gentle glazing drips.
Background: genuinely transparent alpha outside the object and through the central hole. No floor, backdrop, gradient, rectangular card, plate, cast background shadow, or baked-in checkerboard.
Constraints: no text, letters, logos, coin symbols, watermarks, borders, faces, eyes, arms, people, mascots, duplicate donuts, or extra props. Crisp readable silhouette even at small UI sizes.
Variant: classic translucent honey-colored sugar glaze on golden dough, with three tiny restrained warm gold sparkles close to the rim. Keep the donut as the clear main subject.
